title: Cosine, not dot product
statement_md:
Write `cosine(a, b)` returning the cosine similarity of two vectors.

- raise `ValueError` when the lengths differ
- raise `ValueError` when either vector is empty or has zero norm, since the angle is undefined
- return a `float` in `[-1, 1]`, clamped against round-off

Similarity is the angle between two arrows, not the distance between two points.
